---
title: Code Block Test
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # Syntax highlighting is applied on the CLI render path: the
        # outer container carries `sourceCode` and tokens are wrapped
        # in nested `<span class="hl-*">` tags.
        - ["<pre class=\"sourceCode python\"", "<code", "hl-keyword\">def</span>", "hl-function-builtin\">print</span>"]
---
